meta.title: Contact us
meta.description: How to reach Friends of Animals, and where to go with a safeguarding concern.

hero.title: Write to us
hero.lead: Tell us what your message is about, and it reaches the right person sooner.
hero.photoCaption: A street dog trots up to say hello

safety.title: Worried about a child's safety?
safety.body: Please don't wait for an email reply. In an emergency, call <emergency>112</emergency>. For a child who needs help, call Childline on <childline>1098</childline>. For abuse online, report it at <cyberSite>cybercrime.gov.in</cyberSite> or call <cyberLine>1930</cyberLine>.

details.title: How to reach us
details.reply: We aim to reply within 2 working days.
details.form: A contact form is coming. Until then, please use email.

topics.title: What is it about?
topics.lead: Start your subject line with the topic, for example “Schools: our school in Pune”, and tell us what you need.

GENERAL.title: General
GENERAL.body: Questions about Friends of Animals, this website, or anything not listed here.

SCHOOLS.title: Schools
SCHOOLS.body: Bringing a competition to your school. Tell us the school's name, city and the classes you have in mind.

NGOS.title: Animal welfare groups
NGOS.body: NGOs, shelters and rescuers who would like to work with us. Tell us where you work and what you do.

ADOPTION.title: Adoption
ADOPTION.body: We are not a shelter and don't have animals for adoption. Help connecting adopters with shelters is coming later.

VOLUNTEERING.title: Volunteering
VOLUNTEERING.body: Volunteering opens later. Write to us now with your city and how you would like to help, and we will keep your note.

DONATIONS.title: Donations and payments
DONATIONS.body: Questions about giving, a fee you paid, or a refund. Include your registration or receipt number if you have one.

MEDIA.title: Media
MEDIA.body: Journalists and writers. Tell us your publication and your deadline.

safeguarding.title: Safeguarding concern
safeguarding.body: Don't email us about a child at risk. Use the safeguarding page, which explains who to call first.

policies.title: Before you write
policies.body: These pages may already answer your question.
